capabilities.label: Set chart symbol
capabilities.notes: MVP symbol changes are limited by the enabled watchlist.

capabilities.label: Set chart timeframe
capabilities.notes: MVP timeframe changes use supported dummy stream intervals.

capabilities.label: Set chart viewport
capabilities.notes: Viewport commands adjust visible range only and must not resubscribe market data.

capabilities.label: Manage indicators
capabilities.notes: Enabled indicator types are still validated by the indicator registry.

capabilities.label: Manage horizontal line drawings
capabilities.notes: The MVP drawing implementation supports horizontalLine only.

capabilities.label: Set layer visibility
capabilities.notes: Visibility changes apply to existing chart layers.

capabilities.label: Manage comparison symbols
capabilities.notes: Comparison series render as percent-normalized line overlays in the MVP.

capabilities.label: Set panel pin mode
capabilities.notes: Pin mode is a user policy control and is never exposed as an LLM chart edit command.

capabilities.label: Set chart tool
capabilities.notes: Tool selection is a local chart panel UI action.

capabilities.label: Toggle crosshair
capabilities.notes: Crosshair visibility is a user display preference.

capabilities.label: Accept proposal
capabilities.notes: LLM proposals are accepted by user or system policy only.

capabilities.label: Reject proposal
capabilities.notes: Rejecting a proposal must not mutate ChartDocument.

capabilities.label: Future drawing shapes
capabilities.notes: Trend line, rectangle, and text drawing documents exist as future shape concepts but are not implemented in the MVP.

capabilities.label: Future price render modes
capabilities.notes: OHLC and area price rendering are not implemented in the MVP.

capabilities.label: Future indicator render modes
capabilities.notes: Histogram/cloud renderer behavior is not treated as a separate LLM command in the MVP.
